notes:
- Print: choose a paper in Save: US comic, Euro album, Manga (B6), Digest, US Letter, A4, A5, Tabloid, A3, A4 landscape, or a custom size. Pages are laid out again for its shape: small paper gets fewer panels a page, so words never go under 7 pt. A fixed length like 64 pages stays 64 pages.
- Saved PDFs carry the words as real text, so they're sharp at any size.
- Bleed and crop marks for a print shop, or a booklet to print double-sided at home, fold and staple (A5 pages on A4 sheets, Digest on Letter).
